description: Markers only, so `vela where --probe` can tell whether plugin hooks run on this host. No rule depends on them.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; j=$(cat); case "$j" in *'where --probe'*) if [ -e "$d/.vela.yaml" ] || [ -d "$d/.vela" ]; then mkdir -p "$d/.vela" && printf '%s\n' "$j" > "$d/.vela/hook-canary"; fi;; esac; exit 0
